headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 27, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a 6-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Cade Cavalli earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Los Angeles Angels defeated the Detroit Tigers 10-6, with Vaughn Grissom leading the charge at the plate.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Gavin Lux being placed on the 60-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays due to a right shoulder impingement. The Toronto Blue Jays have also made several roster moves, placing José Berríos on the 60-day injured list with a right elbow stress fracture and transferring Alejandro Kirk from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left thumb fracture.

There have been several trades and roster movements in the MLB, including the Detroit Tigers trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, while the Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Guardians 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 6-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Cade Cavalli earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays suffered a 6-1 defeat at the hands of the Baltimore Orioles. Shane Baz pitched 7.0 innings for the Rays, striking out 9 batters and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Angels Soar Past Tigers 10-6**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 10-6 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Vaughn Grissom leading the charge at the plate. Grissom's impressive performance included 3 hits, 1 home run, and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Cubs 12-1 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates handed the Chicago Cubs a lopsided 12-1 loss, securing a convincing victory. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Pirates' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians, marking their latest loss. CJ Abrams, Travis Bazzana, Chase DeLauter, and Angel Martínez were among the impact hitters in the game.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Gavin Lux on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Gavin Lux, the left fielder for the Tampa Bay Rays, has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder impingement. This move is effective immediately.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for LHP Juanmi Vasquez.
